title: ACT ON MANAGEMENT OF FIREFIGHTING EQUIPMENT
full_text:
Article 27 (Service Life of Fire Equipment) (1) The service life of fire equipment shall be determined by the Administrator of the Public Procurement Service pursuant to Article 16-2 (1) of the Commodity Management Act: Provided, That the Fire Commissioner of the National Fire Agency may determine the service life thereof if the Administrator of the Public Procurement Service fails to do so or where it is impractical to apply the service life determined by the Administrator of the Public Procurement Service due to special circumstances, the Fire Commissioner may adjust the service life thereof in consultation with the Administrator.
  (2) Where the head of a fire service agency acquires fire equipment whose service life is not determined, he or she shall request the Fire Commissioner of the National Fire Agency to determine the service life thereof.
  (3) The head of a fire service agency may extend the period of use of fire equipment whose service life has expired within the scope of the maximum period of use for each fire equipment determined by the Fire Commissioner of the National Fire Agency where the performance thereof has been confirmed as prescribed by Presidential Decree. <Amended on Nov. 15, 2022>
